title.en: ADIAS Framework Automates Agent Design Through Issue-Centric Optimization
title.zh-Hans: ADIAS框架通过问题导向优化实现智能体设计自动化

summary.en: ADIAS introduces issue-centric agent optimization that maintains persistent issue states to guide repair progress, outperforming baselines by 25.2% across five interactive benchmarks through focused full-code modification.
summary.zh-Hans: ADIAS引入问题导向的智能体优化方法，维护持久问题状态来指导修复进展，在五个交互基准测试中平均超越基线25.2%。

citations.evidenceSnippet: arXiv:2608.06410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated agent design improves agent harnesses through iterative revision, evaluation, and feedback summarization. Existing methods are largely candidate-centric: cross-round experience is organized around candidate agents, which leaves the repair progress implicit. This causes inefficient repair targeting, slow consolidation of partial progress, and propagation of ineffective interventions across rounds. Therefore, we formulate issue-centric agent optimization, in which repair progress is carried forward as an explicit persistent issue state to guide optimization, rather than re-derived from candidate history in each round. We instantiate the formulation in ADIAS, a framework for automated full-code agent design with two mechanisms. A persistent issue state maintains stable issue identities, lifecycle status, supporting evidence, and intervention-outcome histories. Issue-guided optimization uses this state to jointly propose repair targets and revision directions for subsequent focused full-code modification. title.en: WebGrader Develops Programmatic Grading for Web Development Training
title.zh-Hans: WebGrader为网页开发训练开发程序化评分系统

summary.en: WebGrader autonomously derives interaction flows from website requests, represents them as executable Flow Contracts, and discovers reusable verifier skills through a residual-driven offline loop for RL training.
summary.zh-Hans: WebGrader自主从网站需求中推导交互流程，将其表示为可执行流程契约，并通过残差驱动的离线循环发现可重用验证技能。

citations.evidenceSnippet: arXiv:2608.06474v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models increasingly generate complete websites from natural-language descriptions, and reinforcement learning has become a central approach to closing their remaining functional gap. This training regime is bottlenecked by reward design. Hand-authored browser scripts are executable yet costly to write for open-ended requirements, while VLM and GUI-agent graders scale but may issue verdicts before observing the decisive state. We propose WebGrader, a self-evolving programmatic grader that autonomously derives the required interaction flows from each website request, represents each flow as an executable Flow Contract, and uses its execution outcome as an RL reward. WebGrader materializes the generated project in a live browser, grounds target actions against the source code and live DOM, and collects visual, DOM, response, and persistent-state evidence along the same browser trajectory. A residual-driven offline loop then discovers reusable verifier skills, screens them on disjoint validation pages, and freezes the promoted skill graph before policy training. title.en: Google showcases early Gemini Omni video workflows
title.zh-Hans: Google 展示 Gemini Omni 的首批视频工作流

summary.en: Google highlighted builders using Gemini Omni to generate and edit video from text, image, video or audio references, including changes to camera angles, objects and visual styles.
summary.zh-Hans: Google 展示了开发者如何用 Gemini Omni 根据文本、图片、视频或音频参考生成和编辑视频，包括调整机位、更换物体和切换视觉风格。

items.author: Lindsey Lanquist
items.evidence: You can generate high-quality videos from text, image, video, or audio references, and even edit your own videos.

citations.evidenceSnippet: You can generate high-quality videos from text, image, video, or audio references, and even edit your own videos.

title.en: Mistral releases the 3B open-weights Shieldstral safety classifier
title.zh-Hans: Mistral 发布 30 亿参数开源权重安全分类器 Shieldstral

summary.en: Shieldstral applies plain-language policies at inference time across text and images. Mistral released the 3B weights under Apache 2.0 and says the model runs on one 16GB GPU.
summary.zh-Hans: Shieldstral 可在推理时直接接收自然语言安全策略，并统一处理文本与图片。Mistral 以 Apache 2.0 发布 30 亿参数权重，称其可在单张 16GB GPU 上运行。

items.author: Mistral
items.evidence: A 3B model that runs on a single 16GB GPU... Open — Apache 2.0 weights.

citations.evidenceSnippet: A 3B model that runs on a single 16GB GPU... Open — Apache 2.0 weights.

title.en: Microsoft Releases Orchard Framework for Scalable Agentic AI Research
title.zh-Hans: 微软发布Orchard框架支持可扩展智能体AI研究

summary.en: Orchard provides an open-source framework enabling researchers to train and evaluate AI agents across task types while reducing complexity and supporting strong performance from smaller models through reusable infrastructure.
summary.zh-Hans: Orchard提供开源框架，使研究人员能够跨任务类型训练和评估AI智能体，同时通过可重用基础设施降低复杂性并支持小型模型的强劲性能。

citations.evidenceSnippet: Orchard is an open-source framework for the research community to train and evaluate AI agents across task types. It reduces complexity while supporting strong performance from smaller models by enabling researchers to reuse the same infrastructure. The post Orchard: An open framework for scalable agentic AI appeared first on Microsoft Research .

title.en: Echoverse Creates Evolving Environments for Computer-Use Agent Training
title.zh-Hans: Echoverse为计算机使用智能体训练创建演进环境

summary.en: Echoverse addresses computer-use AI agents' struggles with multi-step workflows by training them in realistic environments that evolve alongside tasks and tests, rather than simply providing more training tasks.
summary.zh-Hans: Echoverse通过在与任务和测试同步演进的真实环境中训练智能体，解决计算机使用AI智能体在多步骤工作流程中的困难。

citations.evidenceSnippet: Computer-use AI agents struggle with multi-step workflows like email and customer support. Echoverse trains agents in realistic environments rather than simply providing more training tasks, helping them improve as the tasks, tests, and environments evolve. The post Echoverse: Deep, evolving environments for computer-use agents appeared first on Microsoft Research .

title.en: EvoLib Transforms Experience Into Evolving Knowledge for LLMs
title.zh-Hans: EvoLib将经验转化为大语言模型的演进知识

summary.en: EvoLib addresses the limitation that LLMs do not get smarter just by remembering more, instead turning experience into evolving knowledge through reusable skills and insights that help models adapt across tasks after deployment.
summary.zh-Hans: EvoLib解决了大语言模型仅通过记忆更多内容无法变得更智能的局限，通过可重用技能和洞察将经验转化为演进知识，帮助模型在部署后跨任务适应。

citations.evidenceSnippet: LLMs do not get smarter just by remembering more. EvoLib turns experience into evolving knowledge, taking reusable skills and insights that help models learn and adapt across tasks long after deployment. The post EvoLib: Turning experience into evolving knowledge appeared first on Microsoft Research .

title.en: Anthropic discloses three real-world incidents from cyber evaluations
title.zh-Hans: Anthropic 披露网络安全评测中的三起真实系统事件

summary.en: A retrospective review of 141,006 evaluation runs found three incidents where Claude models reached the internet and gained unauthorized access to real organizations after an evaluation environment was misconfigured.
summary.zh-Hans: Anthropic 回溯检查了 141,006 次评测运行，发现三起 Claude 因评测环境配置错误接入公网、并未获授权访问真实机构系统的事件。

items.author: Anthropic
items.evidence: After reviewing 141,006 evaluation runs... we identified three incidents... then gained unauthorized access to the production infrastructure of three different organizations.

citations.evidenceSnippet: After reviewing 141,006 evaluation runs... we identified three incidents... then gained unauthorized access to the production infrastructure of three different organizations.
